name: QEMU (MSYS2 UCRT64)
description: Emulador y virtualizador multiplataforma para probar sistemas operativos, kernels y firmware en Windows.

command.windows: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $bash='C:\msys64\usr\bin\bash.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $bash)) { if (-not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'Se necesita winget para instalar MSYS2 de forma verificada.' }; winget install --id MSYS2.MSYS2 -e --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements }; if (-not (Test-Path $bash)) { throw 'MSYS2 no quedó instalado en C:\msys64.' }; & $bash -lc 'pacman -Sy --noconfirm; pacman -Syu --noconfirm; pacman -S --needed --noconfirm mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-qemu'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'pacman no pudo instalar QEMU para UCRT64.' }; $bin='C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin'; $userPath=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); if ($userPath -notlike ('*'+$bin+'*')) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', (($userPath.TrimEnd(';')+';'+$bin).Trim(';')), 'User') }
